products.title: Ash Tool w/Soft Grip Handle for 2XL or XL EGGs
products.body_html:
Ash Tool actually has two functions: you can easily remove the ash in the Big Green Egg with it, but you can also use the tool to distribute the charcoal before lighting the EGG. This practical tool works very well with the Ash Removal Pan.

To optimally manage the temperature when using the EGG, it's important to have as little ash as possible in it. Fortunately, the Ash Tool likes to clean. With the metal fire rake, you can easily remove all ash to the edge, which benefits your dishes. The Ash Tool is available in three sizes and after use, you can easily hang it up.

products.title: All-Natural Palmyra Grid Scrubber with Extra Pad
products.body_html:
The Palmyra Grill Brush offers effective and safe cleaning for your grill. Natural palm bristles effectively remove residue without the risk of metal contamination, ensuring your culinary creations remain pure and safe. The ergonomic 18-inch (45.7 cm) handle provides comfortable, precise control while keeping hands at a safe distance from hot surfaces. A built-in stainless steel scraper tackles stubborn, baked-on remnants with ease.

  • Replaceable scrubber head with one extra pad included
  • Palm bristle pads for thorough, safe cleaning
  • Stainless steel scraper for tough residue
  • 18-inch (45.7 cm) handle for optimal reach and safety

This essential tool seamlessly integrates with your outdoor cooking system, maintaining the pristine condition of your grilling surfaces. By choosing this brush, you're not just cleaning – you're preserving the integrity of every meal you create.

The Diamond-Coated Nylon Bristle Grid Scrubber is a safe and efficient tool for cleaning your grill. Its innovative diamond-coated nylon bristles effortlessly remove stubborn residue from stainless steel and cast iron grids without the risk of metal bristle shedding. The ergonomic, long-handle design (18 inches / 45.7 cm) ensures comfortable use while keeping hands at a safe distance from heat.

This essential tool integrates seamlessly with the egg system, enhancing your overall cooking experience by maintaining pristine grilling surfaces. By starting each session with immaculately clean grids, you unlock the full flavor potential of your ingredients, whether you're searing, smoking, or baking.

  • Durable nylon bristles with diamond coating
  • Compatible with stainless steel and cast iron grids
  • Handle length: 18 inches / 45.7 cm
